evidence.summary: Lockout and throttled events logged as structured warnings with HMAC (per-process-peppered, non-reversible) account_key/address_key, never raw email/password; verified by test and by reading login_throttle.py. Gap (not a criterion failure): only threshold-crossing failures are logged, so sub-threshold/low-and-slow guessing produces no log signal.

rationale: no acceptance criterion requires per-attempt audit logging; recorded as a limitation.
